name: 48047 · New Baltimore, MI
findings: ZIP 48047 (New Baltimore) has 86 nonprofit organizations. 33 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 23 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48047 (New Baltimore) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 48047 (New Baltimore) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 45% of the typical level).
